name: Exec Cluster E04: Pip-Based Risk Unit (FX Scale)
description: Tests: risk_unit stop_unit=pips with FX-scale stop distance
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E04: Pip-Based Risk Unit
# Tests: risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.pips) with large pip distance
# On equities: 1 pip = 0.0001, so 500000 pips ≈ $50 stop distance
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
held = hold_until(is_bull, not is_bull)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.pips, lot_size=1)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=500000)
